records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarter ended December 31, 2022, 37% of revenue was recognized at the point in time control transferred to the customer.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The twelve-month backlog increased in the first quarter of 2023 as compared with the first quarter of 2022 across all of our segments.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The twelve-month backlog increased in Aircraft Controls due to higher orders for our commercial programs.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Gross margin in the first quarter of 2023 benefited from higher sales volumes in Industrial Systems as well as favorable sales mixes in both Aircraft Controls and in Industrial Systems when compared to the same period of 2022.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Net cash provided by operating activities decreased in the first quarter of 2023 compared to the first quarter of 2022.
